reserveReview.rationale: The authored composition remains the dated 2026-09-04 Tron lockedValue scaffold, not a refreshed liability allocation. Research accessed 2026-09-30 confirms the current Tron SA001-A lockedValue and allocator Tron debt both equal $774,431,711, while global allocator debt is $989,941,607 including $215,509,896 Ethereum debt. Positive USDS, USDT, USDT0 and dust USDC positions are disclosed globally across destination chains and operator addresses. The API provides no position-to-origin-debt attribution, constituent token contracts, or shared checkpoint with latest-collateral. Matching the Tron debt alone cannot attribute the cross-chain assets to that envelope. No global fraction is multiplied by the Tron category. The keyed usdd-data-platform:psm-usdc entry is a zero-weight classification (metadata-only) row for the live adapter's Ethereum PSM-USDC-A dust vault ($0.06 lockedValue), verified on 2026-11-23 at Ethereum block 26480780 (hash 0xeb2864c5a2ff50ed9640856fcc8f0ef98c2180b97b44178419636b4912f7f32e, 2026-11-23T22:19:47Z): JOIN_PSM_USDC_A 0x9a7e1b324060db7342aea08c0dc56f55ced6f519 has gem() = canonical USDC 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48, ilk 'PSM-USDC-A', live=1, USDC balance 64288 (0.064288 USDC), and MCD_PSM_USDC_A 0x12d0351f68035a41d13fc8324562e2d51b7a3b93 has tin=20 bps, tout=0 bps, buyEnabled=1; the dated 2026-09-04 Tron scaffold and 2026-09-30 review date are not renewed.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: No third-party custodian exists: reserves sit in USDD protocol contracts (CDP vaults, PSM-USDT vault TSUYvQ5tdd3DijCD1uGunGLpftHuSZ12sQ, and Smart Allocator vaults) whose governance resolves to single-key accounts documented in the mint-authority review. Smart Allocator documentation states the USDD team selects platforms and deploys 'USDD's cash reserve' under team monitoring, so reserve redeployment is discretionary and ongoing; its 2026-08-10 live feed itemizes USDS, USDT, USDT0, and USDC positions across Spark, Aave, JustLend, Morpho, and Venus, but reported debt and deployed holdings do not reconcile exactly at every observation. No trust, SPV, segregation vehicle, or holder claim appears in the Terms of Use or reviewed documentation, so no bankruptcy-remoteness structure is documented. Precedent for unilateral reserve control: roughly 12,000 BTC were removed from collateral in August 2024 without prior DAO approval (existing coin notice). TRX is the subject of the open Clifford et al. v. Tron Foundation et al. class action (SDNY 1:20-cv-2804).
